name: relation_folded_residual_execution
status: native MP-SPDZ execution with exact output reconstruction
scope_warning: All three Semi parties ran on one host and preprocessing is included. This is not a WAN, multi-host, malicious-security, full-MetaQA, or sublinear-ORAM result.

optimization.description: For a relation-partitioned hybrid residual, select the shared secret hop-two relation once for the whole query batch, then resolve only secret entity buckets. Relation selection and residual tag verification are vectorized across queries.
optimization.folded_fetch_products: Q * (relation_count * directory_buckets * bucket_width + frontier_slots * directory_buckets * bucket_width)
optimization.leakage_change: none; all loops and table dimensions remain public and the selected relation, entity buckets, descriptors, and tags are never opened

controlled_ten_query_ablation.protocol: MP-SPDZ Semi, exactly three local parties, passive dishonest majority

initial_scalability_points.note: Dense relation-paged layout; this point validates current v12 code on real data but does not exercise residual folding.
Fresh owner and client shares were prepared with the current setup path before execution.
Historical current-architecture boundary, not rerun under v12 and not a residual-folded layout.

verdict: Residual folding is retained because the controlled executable ablation improves hop-two latency, total latency, communication, rounds, triples, and bytecode while preserving every output. The system is still communication-heavy and only linearly scalable in its public table dimensions. The evidence does not support a practical-scalability claim.
